resources.string: Ironwood is a new shielded pool: the same protocol as Orchard, now formally verified and independently audited. Your funds are safe and your addresses still work.
Your Orchard funds stay until you move them. You can still spend them, but value leaving Orchard is public, so spending publishes an amount on-chain, and it can be larger than you send.

You can move them now. We recommend the private option: it splits your balance into standard-sized pieces that don\'t identify you and sends them in the background over time. Or move everything at once in a single transfer.
Our guide covers what changed and how to move funds yourself instead.
Migration paused for the network upgrade

A private migration started now would still be running when the Zcash network upgrade goes live, and its later transfers couldn\'t be sent. Start it once the upgrade has gone live, or move everything at once in a single transfer.
